search_web_query: search the web using the web_search_tool with a query string and return results
fetch_webpage_url: fetch the contents of a web page at a given URL and extract article as markdown
search_images_query: search for images online using the image_search_tool with a visual query
build_infoquest_client: build an InfoQuestClient with configurable search, fetch, and image search parameters
test_web_search_tool: test the web_search_tool by passing a query and verifying string results
